g.text: Training stays on-prem. Tuning, serving and evidence run on Google Cloud. AWS and Azure feed data over private paths only.

Three producers outside the frame, one Shared VPC across two regions, one service perimeter around every AI service. Every hop is a labeled line; the public internet is drawn once, as the prohibited path.
Shared VPC · prod · one network, two regions
VPC Service Controls perimeter · every AI and data service
Direct VPC egress for every serverless caller · Private Google Access on the subnet · restricted VIP from the Private Google Access doc
Evidence · common folder, outside the perimeter
private data path into Region A
private data path into Region B
Illustrative topology · hop facts are placeholders, not looked-up values
